axes.continuous_question: When governance terminology, risk classes, roles or lifecycle controls change, which frozen items and labels need independent review before a comparable re-run?
compound_semantics: risk-tier classification against the frozen legal key

implementation.present: GovBench, 237 rows, deterministic grading and paired separation on the living board.
implementation.missing: Source-to-item version map, counsel-reviewed label migration and a version-preserving replay pipeline.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Fingerprint governance sources and prepare an unsigned item-impact review request.
axes.human_gate: Counsel and the measurement owner approve interpretation, bank versioning and any board change.

axes.continuous_question: Do new harm and refusal taxonomies expose missing paired safe/unsafe cases or a mismatch between calibrated refusal and the frozen DefBench labels?

implementation.present: DefBench, 36 paired requests and deterministic scoring.
implementation.missing: Versioned threat-to-pair coverage and human-reviewed expansion without rewriting historical results.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Detect taxonomy revisions and propose coverage-gap candidates only.
axes.human_gate: Safety reviewers approve new cases, gold labels and replay admission.

axes.continuous_question: Do provenance-format or Article 50 marking changes alter which marks survive, how validity is computed, or what the model must distinguish?

implementation.present: ProvBench, 32 Article 50 validity items plus a separate Art. 50 byte-inspection workflow.
implementation.missing: Detector/version matrix tied to frozen transformations and counsel-approved label updates.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Watch format and statutory sources; emit a provenance-semantics review request.
axes.human_gate: Format specialists and counsel approve validity predicates and bank versions.

axes.continuous_question: Has the cryptographic assumption, migration guidance or evidence date changed enough to require new post-quantum continuity cases?
compound_semantics: continuity of evidence across algorithm change

implementation.present: PQCBench, 33 frozen items and deterministic status classification.
implementation.missing: A standards-version register and reviewed cryptographic migration fixtures.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Record source revisions and identify assumptions requiring cryptographic review.
axes.human_gate: Cryptography reviewers approve labels; operators authorise re-measurement.

axes.continuous_question: Which MCP specification revisions change protocol obligations, error behaviour or the distinction between tool description and actual server enforcement?

implementation.present: MCPBench, 35 model-comparison items plus a separately measured effect-binding server census.
implementation.missing: Specification-version negotiation matrix and reviewed server replay fixtures.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Fingerprint MCP normative pages and prepare a versioned conformance diff request.
axes.human_gate: Protocol maintainers approve test semantics and independent operators approve server re-probes.

axes.continuous_question: Have licence texts, model-use restrictions or intended-use assumptions changed so that licence-reasoning cases need new labels?

implementation.present: OSSBench, 32 licence-reasoning items.
implementation.missing: Dated licence-text snapshots and counsel-reviewed intended-use mappings.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Preserve candidate licence revisions and request item-impact review.
axes.human_gate: Licensing counsel approves interpretations and bank revisions.

axes.continuous_question: Do machinery-law changes alter Part A scope, safety-function classification or treatment of self-evolving behaviour in the frozen cases?

implementation.present: MachBench, 33 deterministic classification items; no public leader without a signed card.
implementation.missing: Provision-level item mapping, engineer/counsel review and evidence for a separated public result.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Detect official text changes and prepare a scoped classification review.
axes.human_gate: Machinery engineers and counsel approve labels; no conformity decision is automated.

axes.continuous_question: Do updated safety and vulnerability taxonomies reveal cases where protect and help trade-offs, severity labels or paired conduct assumptions need review?

implementation.present: CareBench, 199 rows and a protect-by-help rubric.
implementation.missing: Lived-experience review, escalation fixtures and source-to-severity versioning.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Flag taxonomy changes for scenario and severity review without generating gold labels.
axes.human_gate: Safeguarding specialists and affected-person reviewers approve scenarios and labels.

axes.continuous_question: Do agentic threat and protocol changes alter when an action may proceed, requires confirmation, or must be refused across digital and physical effects?

implementation.present: XRAIV, 32 action-classification items, with the effect-binding census as a separate fact run.
implementation.missing: End-to-end authorised-effect harness, reversible controls and explicit human-confirmation evidence.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Prepare candidate action scenarios and never execute consequential effects.
axes.human_gate: A named operator authorises scope and a human confirms each consequential test action.

axes.continuous_question: Do new provenance formats, detector versions or transformations change the cross-detector compatibility matrix?

implementation.present: DetBench, 33 matrix items; the board withholds an unverifiable leader.
implementation.missing: Executable detector fixtures, signed per-model evidence and an explicit version matrix.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Track detector/format revisions and propose new matrix cells.
axes.human_gate: Provenance engineers validate detector outputs and reviewers admit a replay.

axes.continuous_question: Has the consolidated prohibition text or its authoritative interpretation changed which frozen scenarios trip Article 5 safeguards?

implementation.present: Art5Bench, 36 deterministic legal-scenario items.
implementation.missing: Provision-version mapping and counsel-approved external re-ranking evidence.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Detect source changes and open legal-label review; never issue a breach verdict.
axes.human_gate: Counsel approves legal interpretation and every affected gold label.

axes.continuous_question: Do emerging multi-agent protocols and attacks expose coordination, delegation or collective-escape cases absent from wave 2b?

implementation.present: SwarmBench v2b, 37 items and signed candidate cards; separation remains UNTESTED.
implementation.missing: Current pinned bank, published paired rows and executable multi-agent authority traces.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Propose protocol/threat-derived scenarios and preserve existing measurements.
axes.human_gate: Safety and protocol reviewers approve scenarios; an operator runs the frozen fleet.

axes.continuous_question: Do new manipulation, vulnerability or disclosure findings require revised affect-safety scenarios or severity labels?

implementation.present: AffectBench, 41 items with explicit counsel-pending legal labels.
implementation.missing: Counsel sign-off, affected-person review and updated external comparison evidence.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Collect candidate scenario impacts without inferring psychological harm or legal effect.
axes.human_gate: Safeguarding specialists and counsel approve scenarios, labels and publication.

axes.continuous_question: Do new attack classes require new distinct prompts, detector operating points or a fresh prompt-level separation analysis?

implementation.present: A 71-row gold bank derived from 27 distinct inputs, deterministic detector grading and published zero-FP operating-point results.
implementation.missing: At least 30 distinct prompts for the legacy method gate, broader attack coverage and a prompt-level paired test.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Map attack-taxonomy changes to coverage candidates; do not label synthetic attacks as gold.
axes.human_gate: Adversarial-testing reviewers approve gold prompts, safe execution and separation analysis.

axes.continuous_question: Do protocol revisions or server behaviour changes alter whether caller authorisation binds to the exact request and result, including replay and human confirmation?
compound_semantics: returned evidence and explicit human confirmation

implementation.present: EffectBench v0.1 signed probe over 261 of 600 attempted servers, with controls and fail-capable grading.
implementation.missing: A published method hash, repeat-run scheduling, backend-effect evidence and a consented consequential-action harness.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Watch protocol semantics and schedule read-only review proposals; tool annotations alone never establish trust.
axes.human_gate: Server owners and operators approve scope; people confirm consequential tests and reviewers admit results.

axes.continuous_question: Have issuer account flags, identity domains or the chain reader changed, and do the attestation chain and observed ledger still need to be distinguished?

implementation.present: Signed ChainFacts run over six XRPL issuers with mainnet observations and explicitly separate devnet attestations.
implementation.missing: Repeatable reader snapshots, remaining-instrument coverage and separately authorised mainnet attestation.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Request a read-only ledger re-observation and preserve chain/network identity.
axes.human_gate: Operators approve ledger reads and attestation deployment; counsel keeps risk verdicts unmeasured.

axes.continuous_question: Has an issuer's dated disclosure or applicable reserve-attestation expectations changed the PASS/FAIL/UNCHECKABLE language test?
compound_semantics: reserve observation versus solvency or redemption assurance

implementation.present: ReserveFacts over 16 reader instruments with three-state grading and an unsigned content-addressed run.
implementation.missing: Fresh dated page captures, reviewer-confirmed source semantics and independent signature admission.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Propose a disclosure re-fetch and preserve unreachable sources as UNCHECKABLE.
axes.human_gate: Financial reviewers approve wording predicates and signing; no reserve assurance is inferred.

axes.continuous_question: Have issuer declarations or official regime texts changed whether a governing framework is declared and confirmable?

implementation.present: RegimeFacts over 16 reader rows, deterministic three-state declaration grading.
implementation.missing: Current disclosure captures, jurisdiction-specific legal review and signed rerun admission.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Watch official regimes and propose declaration re-checks, never compliance conclusions.
axes.human_gate: Counsel approves regime mappings and reviewers approve any signed result.

axes.continuous_question: Have supply, holder or reader semantics changed, and can represented and distributed quantities now be compared in the same unit?

implementation.present: DistributionFacts over 16 XRPL reader rows; represented-versus-distributed remains UNCHECKABLE.
implementation.missing: A same-unit external representation source, dated snapshots and independent run signing.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Request a same-schema reader refresh and flag missing comparable units.
axes.human_gate: Data reviewers approve source compatibility and measurement admission.

axes.continuous_question: Have named custodian or auditor disclosures changed, without turning name presence into an assessment of service quality?
compound_semantics: disclosure versus custody or audit quality

implementation.present: CustodyFacts over 16 reader rows with separate three-state custodian and auditor predicates.
implementation.missing: Fresh source captures, independent entity confirmation and signed rerun review.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Propose a disclosure re-check and retain unresolvable entities as UNCHECKABLE.
axes.human_gate: Financial reviewers approve entity evidence; no quality judgement is automated.

axes.continuous_question: Has Eurostat revised the cited enterprise AI-use series, population, size class or comparability metadata?

implementation.present: Two cited isoc_eb_ai component facts for 2025; no composite index.
implementation.missing: Dataset-version monitoring, API-driven rerun and a reviewed component update; no index formula exists.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Detect source revisions and prepare a component-level rerun request.
axes.human_gate: Statistical reviewers validate population, units and revisions before publication.

axes.continuous_question: Have Eurostat labour-force activity or unemployment series, populations or definitions changed?

implementation.present: Two cited 2025 Eurostat component facts from lfsi_emp_a and une_rt_a; no composite index.
implementation.missing: Versioned API extraction, definition review and signed component rerun; no index formula exists.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Watch statistical definitions and request component re-observation only.
axes.human_gate: Statistical reviewers approve series and denominator changes before publication.

axes.continuous_question: Have named vendors changed dated deployment-count disclosures, and what industrial-robot scope limits prevent broader labour or safety inference?
compound_semantics: disclosed count versus fleet size, hours or incidents

implementation.present: Eight frozen vendor URLs graded for dated count disclosure; no composite index and fleet/hours/incidents unmeasured.
implementation.missing: Independent deployment evidence, labour denominators, incident data and any defensible index methodology.

axes.safe_autonomous_action: Detect disclosure revisions and request a fact rerun without estimating missing fleet data.
axes.human_gate: Robotics and labour reviewers approve scope and evidence before any new measure is named.
